concrete_scene.heading: Worked release boundary: one public copy defeats universal recall
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: An official publisher, one public artifact copy, an official withdrawal, a patch channel, and a post-release record
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Describe universal recall after one uncontrolled copy exists.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: Official distribution can stop and patches can propagate, but the record preserves positive public-copy state and says universal recall is unavailable.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether official lineage, withdrawal, license, or patching identifies universal copy control; none does.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Release, incident, derivative, safeguard, benefit, risk, license, copy, and affected-party owners retain post-release residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite review proves a modeled irreversibility boundary and does not release an artifact, observe real copies, enforce licenses, erase derivatives, or establish safety.

worked_trace.heading: Worked release boundary: one public copy defeats universal recall
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Positive public-copy state is incompatible with modeled universal recall; actual distribution, copy observation, license enforcement, derivative safety, benefit, and risk remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The official-channel baseline calls withdrawal revocation. The post-release model distinguishes control of official distribution from unseen public copies.
readable_claim: Open-weight release is an irreversible custody change: after one uncontrolled copy exists, governance can coordinate safer use but cannot truthfully promise universal recall.
normative_rule: Before release, freeze the exact artifact, accessible-frontier comparison, misuse and fine-tuning stress tests, benefit and risk distribution, safer access alternatives, derivative safeguards, incident channels, and residual owners. After release, report patch and coordination reach without claiming control of unseen copies.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene states once that formal irreversibility is not a real release or copy census.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Frontier comparison, misuse, access, copies, safeguards, licenses, incidents, benefit, risk, safety, support, and release remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The one-copy boundary stays reader-facing; full release-case matrices remain in formal evidence.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The short claim makes irreversibility the chapter spine.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The real-copy and safety boundary follows the trace once.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Access-tier tables remain because retained control differs materially across tiers.

non_claims: The worked trace does not publish or recall real model weights.
Official lineage does not establish universal copy control.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
